name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.9.3 — Hotfix two cross-role contamination bugs diagnosed via parallel-session comparison. BUG-О.1: saveRoleHistorySnapshot wrote global _sprint.status to every snapshot, so after validating role A any subsequent save of role B (refresh, working-copy commit, manual save) poisoned role B's history with CONFIRMED status — visible in History spoiler + Excel export. Fixed via new wasValidated parameter: only doValidateRole sets CONFIRMED; all other call-sites preserve existing per-role status from _history or default to PLANNING. BUG-О.2: resumeWorkingDraft loaded only _roleItems[rk] for the role being edited; _roleItems for all other roles remained from the previous context, causing stale role compositions in Planning after «Open for editing» from History. Fixed by iterating ALL_ROLES and loading each _roleItems[otherRk] from its corresponding _history snapshot. Pure runtime fixes; no schema changes. Includes everything from v1.9.0-1.9.2 (Sprint goals + Stand-up assist + dialog timing + viewport scroll). 225 unit tests pass. See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
